criterionOutcomes.criterion: Given a Service point's details have loaded in the shared point-detail dialog, the standard detail presentation shows the returned serving-cell information.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-1-final.png shows loaded Surveyor Service serving-cell information, including 4G, Cell ID 510633_124_4, RSRP -97 dBm and LTE 2100, consistent with the returned values recorded in the result.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Given the loaded Service point details include neighbour-cell data, each returned neighbour appears in its own distinct section beneath the serving-cell information.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-2-loaded-neighbours.png / criterion-2-final.png show three neighbours as rows in one table beside the serving-cell information, rather than distinct sections beneath it.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Given the loaded Service point details contain no neighbour-cell data, serving-cell information remains visible and no empty neighbour section appears.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-3-event-6-loaded.png / criterion-3-final.png show populated serving-cell information for 11:02:01 / -99 dBm alongside an empty Neighbours region reading 'No neighbours are available.' The result records a genuine empty neighbour response.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Given displayed Service point detail rows are available, sorting the rows changes their visible order according to the selected sort, and filtering them shows only rows matching the selected filter.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-4-loaded-details.png and criterion-4-final.png show populated detail rows and no visible sorting/filtering controls, but the serving-cell list extends below the captured viewport. No complete scrolled inspection or attempted sort/filter state is captured, so absence throughout the presentation and the required behaviour cannot be established.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Given a Service point's reported radio generation is 2G, 3G, 4G, 5G NSA, or 5G SA, the visible KPI names are appropriate to that generation.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-5-selected-2g-3g-sa.png shows the correct Surveyor Service technology selection; criterion-5-final.png shows no Service points in the wide view. The result records successful empty point responses for the tested date range/extents. 4G was checked, but 2G/3G/5G SA fixtures were unavailable and 5G NSA was not independently exercised; the full generation assertion remains blocked.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Given 5G SA is selected and the user opens a Service point in the shared point-detail dialog, the Service point detail presentation loads without an error state.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-6-5g-sa-selected.png establishes Service with only 5G SA selected. The result records a successful empty Service points response, leaving no SA record to open. criterion-6-final.png includes unrelated Network Information/RPO layers whose markers do not prove SA Service detail behaviour.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Given Service point details are loading, the detail presentation shows a loading state.
criterionOutcomes.reason: SIMULATED UI STATE: browser-only delay of POST https://o2intelligence-v4-dev.metricell.com/api/platform/surveyor/service/event-analysis for pointId 9533500 / surveyId 1101, established from a genuine populated read. criterion-7-genuine-baseline.png and criterion-7-before-delayed-open.png establish the record and reopening; criterion-7-loading.png / criterion-7-final.png visibly show Analysis progress and 'Loading...' with the current record summary. criterion-7-recovery.png shows populated recovery and criterion-7-cleanup.png closes details/removes the layer. Results record release of the unchanged request, HTTP 200 recovery and exact-handler removal. This proves the explicit loading UI state only, not backend performance or a wholly blank dialog.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Given Service point details are unavailable, the detail presentation shows a no-data state.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-8-populated-baseline.png / criterion-8-final.png show available populated details. No real unavailable-details fixture or authoritative empty-response contract for the Service event-analysis POST was established; the populated response cannot justify inventing a no-data simulation.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Given loading Service point details fails, the detail presentation shows an error state and does not show incorrect detail data.
criterionOutcomes.reason: SIMULATED UI STATE: browser-only HTTP 503 with JSON message on POST https://o2intelligence-v4-dev.metricell.com/api/platform/surveyor/service/event-analysis for target pointId 9532398 / surveyId 1101; a synthetic failed read, not a naturally occurring backend failure. criterion-9-first-record-baseline.png, criterion-9-target-genuine-details.png, criterion-9-first-record-before-error.png and criterion-9-before-error-open.png establish distinct prior/target records and the owned sequence. criterion-9-error-state.png shows 'Unable to load details.' / Retry with target 11:02:01 / -102 dBm and no previous -97 dBm three-neighbour analysis. criterion-9-genuine-recovery.png restores the target's one neighbour; criterion-9-cleanup-restored-map.png shows no layers/details. Results verify exact-handler cleanup and genuine HTTP 200 retry. This proves the explicit Service analysis error UI and absence of stale detail data only, not backend failure handling end to end.
